import suffix_array = "./suffix_array.qui"

class Index(string text, int[] suffixes, int occ_interval, int sample_interval, bool sampled)
    size := int(#text)
    string bwt := [for position := suffixes[] then text[if position == 0 then size - 1 else position - 1]].join("")
    int[] totals := [for symbol := (0:<6)[] then 0]
    for: i < size
        totals[suffix_array.symbol_index(text[i])] += 1
    int[] cumulative := [for symbol := (0:<6)[] then 0]
    for: 1 <= symbol < 6
        cumulative[symbol] = cumulative[symbol - 1] + totals[symbol - 1]
    int[][] checkpoints := []
    int[] running := [for symbol := (0:<6)[] then 0]
    for: i <= size
        if i % occ_interval == 0
            checkpoints = checkpoints.append(running)
        if i < size
            running[suffix_array.symbol_index(bwt[i])] += 1
    int[] samples := [for row := (0:<int(size))[] then (if sampled and suffixes[row] % sample_interval == 0 then suffixes[row] else -1)]

    int occurrence(int symbol, int end)
        checkpoint := end / occ_interval
        result := checkpoints[checkpoint][symbol]
        for: checkpoint * occ_interval <= i < end
            if suffix_array.symbol_index(bwt[i]) == symbol
                result += 1
        return result

    int lf(int row)
        symbol := suffix_array.symbol_index(bwt[row])
        return cumulative[symbol] + occurrence(symbol, row)

    int[] extend(int lower, int upper, string base)
        symbol := suffix_array.symbol_index(base)
        if symbol < 2
            return [0, 0]
        return [cumulative[symbol] + occurrence(symbol, lower), cumulative[symbol] + occurrence(symbol, upper)]

    int[] locate(int row)
        current := row
        steps := 0
        while samples[current] < 0
            current = lf(current)
            steps += 1
        return [samples[current] + steps, steps]

    string inverse()
        reconstructed := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then "$"]
        row := 0
        position := size - 2
        while position >= 0
            reconstructed[position] = bwt[row]
            row = lf(row)
            position -= 1
        return reconstructed.join("")

    int[] backward_search(string query)
        interval := [0, size]
        i := int(#query) - 1
        while i >= 0
            interval = extend(interval[0], interval[1], query[i])
            if interval[0] >= interval[1]
                return interval
            i -= 1
        return interval

import sequence_io = "./sequence_io.qui"
import suffix_array = "./suffix_array.qui"
import fm_index = "./fm_index.qui"
import search = "./search.qui"
import sam_writer = "./sam_writer.qui"

const unreachable := -1000000

int minimum(int first, int second)
    return if first < second then first else second

int maximum(int first, int second)
    return if first > second then first else second

int total(int[] values)
    result := 0
    for value := values[]
        result += value
    return result

bool includes(string text, string character)
    for: i < int(#text)
        if text[i] == character
            return true
    return false

int count_character(string text, string character)
    count := 0
    for: i < int(#text)
        if text[i] == character
            count += 1
    return count

string integer_key(int[] values)
    return [for value := values[] then string(value)].join(",")

class ReferenceText(sequence_io.Reference[] references)
    int[] offsets := []
    offset := 0
    for reference := references[]
        offsets = offsets.append(offset)
        offset += int(#reference.bases) + 1
    string text := [for reference := references[] then reference.bases].join("#") + "$"
    string reverse := text[0:<int(#text) - 1][::-1] + "$"

    int[] position(int absolute_position)
        for: r < int(#references)
            if offsets[r] <= absolute_position and absolute_position < offsets[r] + int(#references[r].bases)
                return [r, absolute_position - offsets[r]]
        return [-1, -1]

    string label(int absolute_position)
        int[] located := position(absolute_position)
        return if located[0] < 0 then "*" else references[located[0]].name + ":{located[1] + 1}"

int[][] operation_runs(string operations)
    int[][] runs := []
    alphabet := "MID"
    for: i < int(#operations)
        operation := 0
        for: j < 3
            if operations[i] == alphabet[j]
                operation = j
        last := int(#runs) - 1
        if last >= 0 and runs[last][0] == operation
            runs[last][1] += 1
        else
            runs = runs.append([operation, 1])
    return runs

class Alignment(int reference, int position, int strand, string operations, int score, string oriented, int[][] pairs, string cigar, int nm, string md)

Alignment describe(int reference, int position, int strand, string operations, int score, string core, int trimmed, sequence_io.Reference[] references)
    oriented := if strand == 0 then core else sequence_io.reverse_complement(core)
    sequence := references[reference].bases
    string[] cigar_parts := []
    string[] md_parts := []
    int[][] pairs := []
    i := 0
    j := position
    matches := 0
    nm := 0
    alphabet := "MID"
    for run := operation_runs(operations)[]
        operation := run[0]
        count := run[1]
        cigar_parts = cigar_parts.append(string(count) + alphabet[operation])
        if operation == 1
            i += count
            nm += count
        elif operation == 2
            md_parts = md_parts.append(string(matches) + "^" + sequence[j:<j + count])
            matches = 0
            j += count
            nm += count
        else
            for: k < count
                pairs = pairs.append([i, j])
                if oriented[i] == sequence[j]
                    matches += 1
                else
                    md_parts = md_parts.append(string(matches) + sequence[j])
                    matches = 0
                    nm += 1
                i += 1
                j += 1
    md_parts = md_parts.append(string(matches))
    if trimmed > 0
        if strand == 0
            cigar_parts = cigar_parts.append("{trimmed}S")
        else
            cigar_parts = ["{trimmed}S"].concat(cigar_parts)
    return Alignment(reference, position, strand, operations, score, oriented, pairs, cigar_parts.join(""), nm, md_parts.join(""))

int band_value(int[][] grid, int[] starts, int row, int column)
    if row < 0 or row >= int(#grid)
        return unreachable
    index := column - starts[row]
    return if index < 0 or index >= int(#grid[row]) then unreachable else grid[row][index]

class Banded(bool exists, int score, int position, string operations)

Banded banded_alignment(string oriented, string sequence, int center, int width, int[] scores)
    length := int(#oriented)
    reference_length := int(#sequence)
    starts := [for i := (0:<(int(length) + 1))[] then maximum(0, i + center - width)]
    ends := [for i := (0:<(int(length) + 1))[] then minimum(reference_length, i + center + width)]
    h := [for i := (0:<(int(length) + 1))[] then [for k := (0:<int(maximum(0, ends[i] - starts[i] + 1)))[] then unreachable]]
    e := h
    f := h
    for: k < int(#h[0])
        h[0][k] = 0
    for: 1 <= i <= length
        if starts[i] > ends[i]
            continue
        for: starts[i] <= j <= ends[i]
            index := j - starts[i]
            previous_h := band_value(h, starts, i - 1, j)
            previous_f := band_value(f, starts, i - 1, j)
            insertion := unreachable
            if previous_h > unreachable
                insertion = previous_h - scores[2] - scores[3]
            if previous_f > unreachable
                insertion = maximum(insertion, previous_f - scores[3])
            f[i][index] = insertion
            deletion := unreachable
            diagonal := unreachable
            if j >= 1
                previous_h = band_value(h, starts, i, j - 1)
                previous_e := band_value(e, starts, i, j - 1)
                if previous_h > unreachable
                    deletion = previous_h - scores[2] - scores[3]
                if previous_e > unreachable
                    deletion = maximum(deletion, previous_e - scores[3])
                previous := band_value(h, starts, i - 1, j - 1)
                if previous > unreachable
                    diagonal = previous + (if oriented[i - 1] == sequence[j - 1] then scores[0] else -scores[1])
            e[i][index] = deletion
            h[i][index] = maximum(diagonal, maximum(deletion, insertion))
    endpoint := -1
    best := unreachable
    if starts[length] <= ends[length]
        for: starts[length] <= j <= ends[length]
            value := band_value(h, starts, length, j)
            if value > best
                best = value
                endpoint = j
    if endpoint < 0
        return Banded(false, 0, 0, "")
    i := length
    j := endpoint
    state := 0
    backward := ""
    while true
        if state == 0
            if i == 0
                break
            previous := if j >= 1 then band_value(h, starts, i - 1, j - 1) else unreachable
            if previous > unreachable
                delta := if oriented[i - 1] == sequence[j - 1] then scores[0] else -scores[1]
                if band_value(h, starts, i, j) == previous + delta
                    backward += "M"
                    i -= 1
                    j -= 1
                    continue
            state = if band_value(f, starts, i, j) > unreachable and band_value(h, starts, i, j) == band_value(f, starts, i, j) then 1 else 2
        elif state == 1
            backward += "I"
            previous := band_value(f, starts, i - 1, j)
            state = if previous > unreachable and band_value(f, starts, i, j) == previous - scores[3] then 1 else 0
            i -= 1
        else
            backward += "D"
            previous := band_value(e, starts, i, j - 1)
            state = if previous > unreachable and band_value(e, starts, i, j) == previous - scores[3] then 2 else 0
            j -= 1
    return Banded(true, best, j, backward[::-1])

bool position_before(Alignment first, Alignment second)
    if first.reference != second.reference
        return first.reference < second.reference
    if first.position != second.position
        return first.position < second.position
    return first.strand < second.strand

Alignment[] rank_alignments(Alignment[] values)
    Alignment[] result := []
    for value := values[]
        position := int(#result)
        for: i < int(#result)
            if value.score > result[i].score or (value.score == result[i].score and position_before(value, result[i]))
                position = i
                break
        result = result[0:<position].concat([value]).concat(result[position:<int(#result)])
    return result

class Result(sequence_io.Read read, string core, int[] qualities, int length, int trimmed, bool mapped, string reason, string method, int score, int mapq, int x0, int x1, Alignment[] alignments, int[] targets)

class Mapper(ReferenceText reference_text, fm_index.Index forward, fm_index.Index reverse, sequence_io.Params params)
    search_counts := [0, 0, 0, 0]
    seed_counts := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]

    Alignment[] hit_alignments(int[][] hits, Result result)
        size := int(#reference_text.references)
        base := forward.size + 1
        keys := [for i := (0:<int(#hits))[] then (((hits[i][0] * size + hits[i][1]) * base + hits[i][2]) * 2 + hits[i][3]) * int(#hits) + i]
        order := [for key := keys.sorted()[] then key % int(#hits)]
        best := hits[order[0]][0]
        Alignment[] alignments := []
        for index := order[]
            hit := hits[index]
            if hit[0] <= best + 1
                score := (result.length - hit[0]) * params.scores[0] - hit[0] * params.scores[1]
                alignments = alignments.append(describe(hit[1], hit[2], hit[3], "M" * nat(result.length), score, result.core, result.trimmed, reference_text.references))
        return alignments

    int[][] .make_candidates(string[] oriented)
        distinct<string> seen
        int[][] candidates := []
        for: strand < 2
            sequence := oriented[strand]
            for: 0 <= offset <= int(#sequence) - params.seed_length step params.seed_step
                seed_counts[1] += 1
                seed := sequence[offset:<offset + params.seed_length]
                if includes(seed, "N")
                    seed_counts[2] += 1
                    continue
                interval := forward.backward_search(seed)
                if interval[1] - interval[0] > params.seed_hits
                    seed_counts[3] += 1
                elif interval[0] >= interval[1]
                    seed_counts[4] += 1
                else
                    for: interval[0] <= row < interval[1]
                        located := reference_text.position(forward.locate(row)[0])
                        candidate := [strand, located[0], located[1] - offset]
                        key := integer_key(candidate)
                        if not seen.has(key)
                            .seen.add(key)
                            candidates = candidates.append(candidate)
        seed_counts[5] += int(#candidates)
        base := forward.size + 201
        size := int(#reference_text.references)
        count := int(#candidates)
        keys := [for i := (0:<int(count))[] then ((candidates[i][0] * size + candidates[i][1]) * base + candidates[i][2] + 100) * count + i]
        return [for key := keys.sorted()[] then candidates[key % count]]

    Result .map_read(sequence_io.Read read)
        int[] qualities := [for code := read.quality.codepoints()[] then code - 33]
        length := int(#read.bases)
        while length > 0 and qualities[length - 1] < params.trim_quality
            length -= 1
        trimmed := int(#read.bases) - length
        core := read.bases[0:<length]
        result := Result(read, core, qualities, length, trimmed, false, "SHORT", "", 0, 0, 0, 0, [], [])
        if length < params.min_length
            return result
        oriented := [core, sequence_io.reverse_complement(core)]
        plus_exact := forward.backward_search(oriented[0])
        minus_exact := forward.backward_search(oriented[1])
        allowed := if plus_exact[0] < plus_exact[1] or minus_exact[0] < minus_exact[1] then 1 else params.mismatches
        int[][] hits := []
        for: strand < 2
            found := search.backtrack(oriented[strand], allowed, forward, reverse)
            search_counts[0] += 1
            search_counts[1] += found.nodes
            search_counts[2] += int(#found.leaves)
            search_counts[3] += found.positions
            for leaf := found.leaves[]
                for: leaf[0] <= row < leaf[1]
                    located := reference_text.position(forward.locate(row)[0])
                    hits = hits.append([leaf[2], located[0], located[1], strand])
        if #hits != 0
            result.alignments = hit_alignments(hits, result)
            result.mapped = true
            best := length
            for hit := hits[]
                if hit[0] < best
                    best = hit[0]
            result.x0 = int(#[for hit := hits[] if hit[0] == best then hit])
            result.x1 = int(#[for hit := hits[] if hit[0] == best + 1 then hit])
            result.method = if best == 0 then "EXACT" else "MISMATCH"
            result.score = (length - best) * params.scores[0] - best * params.scores[1]
            result.mapq = if result.x0 >= 2 then 0 elif result.x1 == 0 then 60 - 12 * best else maximum(30 - 12 * best - 3 * result.x1, 1)
            for: r < int(#reference_text.references)
                if #[for hit := hits[] if hit[0] == best and hit[1] == r then hit] != 0
                    result.targets = result.targets.append(r)
            return result
        result.reason = "NOHIT"
        if length < params.seed_length
            return result
        seed_counts[0] += 1
        int[][] candidates := .make_candidates(oriented)
        Alignment[] accepted := []
        for candidate := candidates[]
            strand := candidate[0]
            r := candidate[1]
            aligned := banded_alignment(oriented[strand], reference_text.references[r].bases, candidate[2], params.band, params.scores)
            if not aligned.exists or 100 * aligned.score < params.min_percent * params.scores[0] * length
                continue
            item := describe(r, aligned.position, strand, aligned.operations, aligned.score, core, trimmed, reference_text.references)
            previous := -1
            for: i < int(#accepted)
                if accepted[i].reference == r and accepted[i].position == item.position and accepted[i].strand == strand
                    previous = i
                    break
            if previous < 0
                accepted = accepted.append(item)
            elif item.score > accepted[previous].score
                accepted[previous] = item
        seed_counts[6] += int(#accepted)
        if #accepted == 0
            return result
        result.alignments = rank_alignments(accepted)
        result.mapped = true
        result.method = "SEED"
        result.score = result.alignments[0].score
        result.x0 = int(#[for item := accepted[] if item.score == result.score then item])
        result.x1 = int(#accepted) - result.x0
        second := 0
        for item := accepted[]
            if item.score < result.score and item.score > second
                second = item.score
        result.mapq = if result.x0 >= 2 then 0 else 60 * (result.score - second) / result.score
        for: r < int(#reference_text.references)
            if #[for item := accepted[] if item.score == result.score and item.reference == r then item] != 0
                result.targets = result.targets.append(r)
        return result

string bwt_run_text(string bwt)
    count := 0
    for: i < int(#bwt)
        if i == 0 or bwt[i] != bwt[i - 1]
            count += 1
    return "bwt runs {count} head " + bwt[0:<minimum(60, int(#bwt))]

string symbol_values(int[] values)
    return [for i := (0:<6)[] then suffix_array.symbols[i] + " {values[i]}"].join(" ")

string sam_record(Result result, sequence_io.Reference[] references, int maximum_alternatives)
    read := result.read
    if not result.mapped
        return sam_writer.unmapped(read.name, read.bases, read.quality, result.reason)
    primary := result.alignments[0]
    reverse := primary.strand == 1
    bases := if reverse then sequence_io.reverse_complement(read.bases) else read.bases
    quality := if reverse then read.quality[::-1] else read.quality
    alternatives := ""
    others := int(#result.alignments) - 1
    if others >= 1 and others <= maximum_alternatives
        for: 1 <= i < int(#result.alignments)
            item := result.alignments[i]
            strand := if item.strand == 0 then "+" else "-"
            alternatives += references[item.reference].name + ",{strand}{item.position + 1},{item.cigar},{item.nm};"
    return sam_writer.mapped(read.name, if reverse then 16 else 0, references[primary.reference].name, primary.position, result.mapq, primary.cigar, bases, quality, primary.nm, primary.md, result.score, result.x0, result.x1, result.method, alternatives)

class Study(sequence_io.Input data)
    sequence_io.Params params := data.params
    sequence_io.Reference[] references := data.references
    reference_text := ReferenceText(references)
    string text := reference_text.text
    size := int(#text)
    suffix_array.Built forward_sa := suffix_array.build(text)
    suffix_array.Built reverse_sa := suffix_array.build(reference_text.reverse)
    forward := fm_index.Index(text, forward_sa.suffixes, params.occ_interval, params.sample_interval, true)
    reverse := fm_index.Index(reference_text.reverse, reverse_sa.suffixes, params.occ_interval, params.sample_interval, false)
    mapper := Mapper(reference_text, forward, reverse, params)
    Result[] results := []
    for read := data.reads[]
        results = results.append(.mapper.map_read(read))
    int[][] depths := [for reference := references[] then [for p := (0:<int(#reference.bases))[] then 0]]
    mapq0_starts := depths
    int[][][][] pileup := [for reference := references[] then [for p := (0:<int(#reference.bases))[] then [for strand := (0:<2)[] then [for base := (0:<4)[] then 0]]]]
    for result := results[]
        if not result.mapped
            continue
        local primary := result.alignments[0]
        if result.mapq == 0
            mapq0_starts[primary.reference][primary.position] += 1
        if result.mapq < params.coverage_mapq
            continue
        for pair := primary.pairs[]
            depths[primary.reference][pair[1]] += 1
            local base := suffix_array.symbol_index(primary.oriented[pair[0]]) - 2
            local cycle := if primary.strand == 0 then pair[0] + 1 else result.length - pair[0]
            if base >= 0 and result.qualities[cycle - 1] >= params.variants[1]
                pileup[primary.reference][pair[1]][primary.strand][base] += 1

    string[] index_lines()
        lines := ["text length {size} sequences {#references}"]
        for: r < int(#references)
            reference := references[r]
            gc := count_character(reference.bases, "G") + count_character(reference.bases, "C")
            lines = lines.append("sequence {reference.name} length {#reference.bases} offset {reference_text.offsets[r]} gc " + sam_writer.ratio(gc, int(#reference.bases)) + " masked {reference.masked}")
        lines = lines.concat(["symbols " + symbol_values(forward.totals), "", "forward_index", "suffix_array rounds {int(#forward_sa.classes) - 1}"])
        for: t < int(#forward_sa.classes)
            lines = lines.append("round {t} prefix_length {2 ^ t} classes {forward_sa.classes[t]}")
        checked := suffix_array.adjacent_check(text, forward_sa.suffixes)
        lines = lines.append("sa_check pairs {size - 1} ordered {checked.ordered} lcp_sum {checked.lcp_sum} mean_lcp " + sam_writer.ratio(checked.lcp_sum, size - 1) + " max_lcp {checked.maximum}")
        string first := reference_text.label(forward_sa.suffixes[checked.longest_row - 1])
        string second := reference_text.label(forward_sa.suffixes[checked.longest_row])
        lines = lines.append("longest_repeat {checked.maximum} {first} {second}")
        map<string, int> kmers
        occurrences := 0
        for position := forward_sa.suffixes[]
            if position + params.seed_length > size
                continue
            kmer := text[position:<position + params.seed_length]
            if includes(kmer, "#") or includes(kmer, "$")
                continue
            old := 0
            match kmers.get(kmer)
                int found
                    old = found
                none
                    old = 0
            .kmers.set(kmer, old + 1)
            occurrences += 1
        unique := 0
        max_occurrence := 0
        for count := kmers.values()[]
            if count == 1
                unique += 1
            if count > max_occurrence
                max_occurrence = count
        lines = lines.append("kmers length {params.seed_length} occurrences {occurrences} distinct {kmers.size()} unique {unique} max_occurrence {max_occurrence} unique_fraction " + sam_writer.ratio(unique, occurrences))
        sample_count := int(#[for sample := forward.samples[] if sample >= 0 then sample])
        lines = lines.concat([bwt_run_text(forward.bwt), "c_array " + symbol_values(forward.cumulative), "occ interval {params.occ_interval} checkpoints {#forward.checkpoints}", "sa_sample interval {params.sample_interval} samples {sample_count}"])
        correct := 0
        total_steps := 0
        max_steps := 0
        for: row < size
            int[] located := forward.locate(row)
            if located[0] == forward_sa.suffixes[row]
                correct += 1
            total_steps += located[1]
            if located[1] > max_steps
                max_steps = located[1]
        lines = lines.append("locate rows {size} correct {correct} total_steps {total_steps} max_steps {max_steps} mean_steps " + sam_writer.ratio(total_steps, size))
        lines = lines.concat(["inverse_bwt identical " + (if forward.inverse() == text then "yes" else "no"), "", "reverse_index", "suffix_array rounds {int(#reverse_sa.classes) - 1}"])
        reverse_check := suffix_array.adjacent_check(reference_text.reverse, reverse_sa.suffixes)
        lines = lines.concat(["sa_check pairs {size - 1} ordered {reverse_check.ordered}", bwt_run_text(reverse.bwt), "inverse_bwt identical " + (if reverse.inverse() == reference_text.reverse then "yes" else "no"), "", "direct_sort"])
        direct_count := 0
        for reference := references[]
            if int(#reference.bases) <= params.direct_limit
                doubled := suffix_array.build(reference.bases + "$")
                identical := doubled.suffixes == suffix_array.direct_sort(reference.bases + "$")
                lines = lines.append("{reference.name} length {int(#reference.bases) + 1} rounds {int(#doubled.classes) - 1} identical " + (if identical then "yes" else "no"))
                direct_count += 1
        if direct_count == 0
            lines = lines.append("none")
        occ_bytes := 24 * int(#forward.checkpoints)
        sample_bytes := 4 * sample_count
        bitmap_bytes := (size + 7) / 8
        index_bytes := size + occ_bytes + sample_bytes + bitmap_bytes
        return lines.concat(["", "index_size bwt_bytes {size} occ_bytes {occ_bytes} sample_bytes {sample_bytes} bitmap_bytes {bitmap_bytes} total_bytes {index_bytes} full_bytes {5 * size} ratio " + sam_writer.ratio(index_bytes, 5 * size)])

    string[] sam_lines()
        names := [for reference := references[] then reference.name]
        lengths := [for reference := references[] then int(#reference.bases)]
        lines := sam_writer.header(names, lengths)
        for result := results[]
            lines = lines.append(sam_record(result, references, params.max_alternatives))
        return lines

    string[] coverage_lines()
        lines := ["window {params.coverage_window} min_mapq {params.coverage_mapq}"]
        for: r < int(#references)
            reference := references[r]
            length := int(#reference.bases)
            values := depths[r]
            covered := int(#[for value := values[] if value > 0 then value])
            depth_sum := total(values)
            max_depth := values.sorted()[length - 1]
            lines = lines.append("reference {reference.name} length {length} covered {covered} breadth " + sam_writer.ratio(covered, length) + " mean_depth " + sam_writer.ratio(depth_sum, length) + " max_depth {max_depth}")
            string[] histogram := []
            for: depth <= max_depth
                count := int(#[for value := values[] if value == depth then value])
                histogram = histogram.append("{depth}:{count}")
            lines = lines.append("depth_histogram " + histogram.join(" "))
            for: 0 <= first < length step params.coverage_window
                last := minimum(first + params.coverage_window, length)
                count := last - first
                window := values[first:<last]
                fragment := reference.bases[first:<last]
                gc := count_character(fragment, "G") + count_character(fragment, "C")
                sum := total(window)
                maximum_depth := window.sorted()[count - 1]
                zero := int(#[for value := window[] if value == 0 then value])
                mapq0 := total(mapq0_starts[r][first:<last])
                lines = lines.append("{reference.name} {first + 1} {last} gc " + sam_writer.ratio(gc, count) + " sum {sum} mean " + sam_writer.ratio(sum, count) + " max {maximum_depth} zero {zero} mapq0 {mapq0} |" + "#" * nat(10 * sum / count))
        return lines

    string[] variant_lines()
        settings := params.variants
        lines := ["min_depth {settings[0]} min_base_quality {settings[1]} min_alt_percent {settings[2]} hom_percent {settings[3]}"]
        callable := 0
        variants := 0
        heterozygous := 0
        homozygous := 0
        for: r < int(#references)
            reference := references[r]
            for: position < int(#reference.bases)
                counts := [for base := (0:<4)[] then pileup[r][position][0][base] + pileup[r][position][1][base]]
                depth := total(counts)
                if depth < settings[0]
                    continue
                callable += 1
                reference_base := suffix_array.symbol_index(reference.bases[position]) - 2
                alternative := if reference_base == 0 then 1 else 0
                for: base < 4
                    if base != reference_base and counts[base] > counts[alternative]
                        alternative = base
                alt_count := counts[alternative]
                if alt_count < 2 or 100 * alt_count < settings[2] * depth
                    continue
                variants += 1
                homo := 100 * alt_count >= settings[3] * depth
                if homo
                    homozygous += 1
                else
                    heterozygous += 1
                genotype := if homo then "1/1" else "0/1"
                counts_text := [for count := counts[] then string(count)].join(" ")
                lines = lines.append("{reference.name} {position + 1} {reference.bases[position]}>" + suffix_array.bases[alternative] + " depth {depth} alt {alt_count} fraction " + sam_writer.ratio(alt_count, depth) + " genotype {genotype} strands {pileup[r][position][0][alternative]} {pileup[r][position][1][alternative]} counts {counts_text}")
        return lines.append("callable {callable} variants {variants} heterozygous {heterozygous} homozygous {homozygous}")

    int[] distinct_values(int[] values)
        int[] result := []
        for value := values.sorted()[]
            if #result == 0 or value != result[-1]
                result = result.append(value)
        return result

    string[] summary_lines()
        read_count := int(#results)
        mapped := [for i := (0:<int(read_count))[] if results[i].mapped then i]
        unique := [for i := mapped[] if results[i].x0 == 1 then i]
        multi := [for i := mapped[] if results[i].x0 >= 2 then i]
        short := int(#[for result := results[] if not result.mapped and result.reason == "SHORT" then result])
        trimmed_reads := int(#[for result := results[] if result.trimmed > 0 then result])
        trimmed_bases := total([for result := results[] then result.trimmed])
        lines := ["reads total {read_count} trimmed {trimmed_reads} trimmed_bases {trimmed_bases} short {short}",
            "mapped {#mapped} rate " + sam_writer.ratio(int(#mapped), read_count) + " unique {#unique} multi {#multi} unmapped {read_count - int(#mapped)}",
            "unmapped short {short} nohit {read_count - int(#mapped) - short}"]
        method_names := ["EXACT", "MISMATCH", "SEED"]
        method_counts := [for method := method_names[] then int(#[for i := mapped[] if results[i].method == method then i])]
        forward_count := int(#[for i := mapped[] if results[i].alignments[0].strand == 0 then i])
        lines = lines.concat(["method exact {method_counts[0]} mismatch {method_counts[1]} seed {method_counts[2]}", "strand forward {forward_count} reverse {int(#mapped) - forward_count}"])
        for: r < int(#references)
            indices := [for i := mapped[] if results[i].alignments[0].reference == r then i]
            unique_count := int(#[for i := indices[] if results[i].x0 == 1 then i])
            plus_count := int(#[for i := indices[] if results[i].alignments[0].strand == 0 then i])
            lines = lines.append("reference {references[r].name} mapped {#indices} unique {unique_count} forward {plus_count} reverse {int(#indices) - plus_count}")
        lengths := [for result := results[] then result.length]
        ordered_lengths := lengths.sorted()
        first_bin := ordered_lengths[0] / 10 * 10
        last_bin := ordered_lengths[read_count - 1] / 10 * 10
        lines = lines.append("length_bins")
        for: first_bin <= lower <= last_bin step 10
            indices := [for i := (0:<int(read_count))[] if lower <= lengths[i] and lengths[i] <= lower + 9 then i]
            mapped_count := int(#[for i := indices[] if results[i].mapped then i])
            unique_count := int(#[for i := indices[] if results[i].mapped and results[i].x0 == 1 then i])
            lines = lines.append("{lower}-{lower + 9} reads {#indices} mapped {mapped_count} unique {unique_count}")
        n_reads := [for i := (0:<int(read_count))[] if includes(results[i].read.bases, "N") then i]
        n_bases := total([for i := n_reads[] then count_character(results[i].read.bases, "N")])
        mapped_n := int(#[for i := n_reads[] if results[i].mapped then i])
        lines = lines.concat(["n_reads {#n_reads} n_bases {n_bases} mapped {mapped_n}", "multi_targets"])
        map<string, int> target_counts
        for i := multi[]
            name_set := [for r := results[i].targets[] then references[r].name].join("+")
            old := 0
            match target_counts.get(name_set)
                int found
                    old = found
                none
                    old = 0
            .target_counts.set(name_set, old + 1)
        if target_counts.size() == 0
            lines = lines.append("none")
        else
            for key := target_counts.keys().sorted()[]
                match target_counts.get(key)
                    int count
                        lines = lines.append("{key} {count}")
                    none
                        continue
        lines = lines.append("mapq_histogram")
        int[] mapqs := distinct_values([for i := mapped[] then results[i].mapq]).sorted(descending = true)
        for mapq := mapqs[]
            count := int(#[for i := mapped[] if results[i].mapq == mapq then i])
            lines = lines.append("{mapq} {count}")
        lines = lines.append("nm_histogram")
        int[] nm_values := distinct_values([for i := mapped[] then results[i].alignments[0].nm])
        for nm := nm_values[]
            count := int(#[for i := mapped[] if results[i].alignments[0].nm == nm then i])
            lines = lines.append("{nm} {count}")
        max_length := [for result := results[] then int(#result.read.bases)].sorted()[read_count - 1]
        aligned := 0
        mismatches := 0
        substitutions := [for base := (0:<4)[] then [for other := (0:<5)[] then 0]]
        cycle_aligned := [for cycle := (0:<int(max_length))[] then 0]
        cycle_mismatches := cycle_aligned
        quality_counts := [0, 0]
        quality_sums := [0, 0]
        quality_aligned := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
        quality_mismatches := quality_aligned
        insertion_events := 0
        inserted_bases := 0
        deletion_events := 0
        deleted_bases := 0
        for index := unique[]
            result := results[index]
            primary := result.alignments[0]
            reference := references[primary.reference].bases
            for pair := primary.pairs[]
                i := pair[0]
                j := pair[1]
                cycle := if primary.strand == 0 then i + 1 else result.length - i
                quality := result.qualities[cycle - 1]
                reference_base := suffix_array.symbol_index(reference[j]) - 2
                oriented_base := suffix_array.symbol_index(primary.oriented[i]) - 2
                if oriented_base < 0
                    oriented_base = 4
                mismatch := primary.oriented[i] != reference[j]
                error_index := if mismatch then 1 else 0
                quality_bin := minimum(quality / 10, 4)
                aligned += 1
                substitutions[reference_base][oriented_base] += 1
                cycle_aligned[cycle - 1] += 1
                quality_counts[error_index] += 1
                quality_sums[error_index] += quality
                quality_aligned[quality_bin] += 1
                if mismatch
                    mismatches += 1
                    cycle_mismatches[cycle - 1] += 1
                    quality_mismatches[quality_bin] += 1
            for run := operation_runs(primary.operations)[]
                if run[0] == 1
                    insertion_events += 1
                    inserted_bases += run[1]
                elif run[0] == 2
                    deletion_events += 1
                    deleted_bases += run[1]
        lines = lines.concat(["error_profile aligned_bases {aligned} mismatches {mismatches} rate " + sam_writer.ratio(mismatches, aligned), "substitutions", "ref A C G T N"])
        for: base < 4
            lines = lines.append(suffix_array.bases[base] + " " + [for count := substitutions[base][] then string(count)].join(" "))
        lines = lines.append("mismatch_by_cycle")
        for: cycle < max_length
            lines = lines.append("cycle {cycle + 1} aligned {cycle_aligned[cycle]} mismatches {cycle_mismatches[cycle]} rate " + sam_writer.ratio(cycle_mismatches[cycle], cycle_aligned[cycle]))
        lines = lines.append("quality matched {quality_counts[0]} mean " + sam_writer.ratio(quality_sums[0], quality_counts[0]) + " mismatched {quality_counts[1]} mean " + sam_writer.ratio(quality_sums[1], quality_counts[1]))
        lines = lines.append("quality_bins")
        bins := ["0-9", "10-19", "20-29", "30-39", "40-"]
        for: bin_index < 5
            lines = lines.append("{bins[bin_index]} aligned {quality_aligned[bin_index]} mismatches {quality_mismatches[bin_index]} rate " + sam_writer.ratio(quality_mismatches[bin_index], quality_aligned[bin_index]))
        cigar := [0, 0, 0, 0]
        for index := mapped[]
            result := results[index]
            for run := operation_runs(result.alignments[0].operations)[]
                cigar[run[0]] += run[1]
            cigar[3] += result.trimmed
        int[] searches := mapper.search_counts
        int[] seeds := mapper.seed_counts
        return lines.concat(["cigar M {cigar[0]} I {cigar[1]} D {cigar[2]} S {cigar[3]}",
            "indels insertions {insertion_events} {inserted_bases} deletions {deletion_events} {deleted_bases}",
            "search dfs_calls {searches[0]} dfs_nodes {searches[1]} dfs_leaves {searches[2]} dfs_positions {searches[3]}",
            "seeds reads {seeds[0]} seeds {seeds[1]} with_n {seeds[2]} repetitive {seeds[3]} without_hit {seeds[4]} candidates {seeds[5]} passing {seeds[6]}"])

string ratio(int numerator, int denominator)
    if denominator == 0
        return "-"
    rounded := (20000 * numerator + denominator) / (2 * denominator)
    fraction := string(rounded % 10000)
    return string(rounded / 10000) + "." + "0" * nat(4 - int(#fraction)) + fraction

string[] header(string[] names, int[] lengths)
    lines := [["@HD", "VN:1.6", "SO:unsorted"].join(HT)]

    return lines.append(["@PG", "ID:fm_index_aligner", "PN:fm_index_aligner", "VN:1.0"].join(HT))

string unmapped(string name, string bases, string quality, string reason)

string mapped(string name, int flag, string reference, int position, int mapq, string cigar, string bases, string quality, int nm, string md, int score, int x0, int x1, string method, string alternatives)

    return fields.join(HT)

import fm_index = "./fm_index.qui"

int[] lower_bounds(string sequence, fm_index.Index reverse)
    z := 0
    interval := [0, reverse.size]
    int[] bounds := []
    for: i < int(#sequence)
        interval = reverse.extend(interval[0], interval[1], sequence[i])
        if interval[0] >= interval[1]
            z += 1
            interval = [0, reverse.size]
        bounds = bounds.append(z)
    return bounds

class Result(int nodes, int[][] leaves, int positions)

Result backtrack(string sequence, int maximum, fm_index.Index forward, fm_index.Index reverse)
    bounds := lower_bounds(sequence, reverse)
    int[][] stack := [[int(#sequence) - 1, maximum, 0, forward.size]]
    nodes := 0
    int[][] leaves := []
    positions := 0
    bases := "ACGT"
    while #stack != 0
        state := stack[-1]
        stack = stack[0:<int(#stack) - 1]
        nodes += 1
        i := state[0]
        z := state[1]
        lower_bound := if i < 0 then 0 else bounds[i]
        if z < lower_bound
            continue
        if i == -1
            leaves = leaves.append([state[2], state[3], maximum - z])
            positions += state[3] - state[2]
            continue
        base := 3
        while base >= 0
            interval := forward.extend(state[2], state[3], bases[base])
            if interval[0] < interval[1]
                if bases[base] == sequence[i]
                    stack = stack.append([i - 1, z, interval[0], interval[1]])
                elif z >= 1
                    stack = stack.append([i - 1, z - 1, interval[0], interval[1]])
            base -= 1
    return Result(nodes, leaves, positions)

string uppercase(string text)
    result := ""
    lower := "acgt"
    upper := "ACGT"
    for: i < int(#text)
        character := text[i]
        for: j < 4
            if character == lower[j]
                character = upper[j]
                break
        result += character
    return result

string reverse_complement(string text)
    bases := "ACGTN"
    complements := "TGCAN"
    result := ""
    i := int(#text) - 1
    while i >= 0
        for: j < 5
            if text[i] == bases[j]
                result += complements[j]
                break
        i -= 1
    return result

    return Input(references, reads, params)

const symbols := "$#ACGT"
const bases := "ACGT"

int symbol_index(string character)
    for: i < 6
        if character == symbols[i]
            return i
    return -1

int[] counting_sort(int[] positions, int[] keys, int key_count)
    counts := [for i := (0:<int(key_count))[] then 0]
    for position := positions[]
        counts[keys[position]] += 1
    offset := 0
    for: key < key_count
        count := counts[key]
        counts[key] = offset
        offset += count
    result := [for i := (0:<int(#positions))[] then 0]
    for position := positions[]
        key := keys[position]
        result[counts[key]] = position
        counts[key] += 1
    return result

class Built(int[] suffixes, int[] classes)

Built build(string text)
    size := int(#text)
    positions := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then i]
    codes := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then symbol_index(text[i])]
    order := counting_sort(positions, codes, 6)
    ranks := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then 0]
    count := 0
    previous := -1
    for position := order[]
        if codes[position] != previous
            count += 1
            previous = codes[position]
        ranks[position] = count - 1
    classes := [count]
    width := 1
    while count < size
        second := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then (if i + width < size then ranks[i + width] + 1 else 0)]
        order = counting_sort(positions, second, count + 1)
        order = counting_sort(order, ranks, count)
        updated := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then 0]
        count = 0
        previous_first := -1
        previous_second := -1
        for position := order[]
            if ranks[position] != previous_first or second[position] != previous_second
                count += 1
                previous_first = ranks[position]
                previous_second = second[position]
            updated[position] = count - 1
        ranks = updated
        classes = classes.append(count)
        width *= 2
    return Built(order, classes)

bool suffix_before(string text, int first, int second)
    common := 0
    while text[first + common] == text[second + common]
        common += 1
    return symbol_index(text[first + common]) < symbol_index(text[second + common])

int[] merge_order(string text, int[] positions)
    size := int(#positions)
    if size < 2
        return positions
    middle := size / 2
    left := merge_order(text, positions[0:<middle])
    right := merge_order(text, positions[middle:<size])
    int[] result := []
    a := 0
    b := 0
    while a < int(#left) and b < int(#right)
        if suffix_before(text, left[a], right[b])
            result = result.append(left[a])
            a += 1
        else
            result = result.append(right[b])
            b += 1
    return result.concat(left[a:<int(#left)]).concat(right[b:<int(#right)])

int[] direct_sort(string text)
    return merge_order(text, [for i := (0:<int(#text))[] then i])

class Check(int ordered, int lcp_sum, int maximum, int longest_row)

Check adjacent_check(string text, int[] suffixes)
    ordered := 0
    lcp_sum := 0
    maximum := -1
    longest_row := 1
    for: 1 <= row < int(#suffixes)
        left := suffixes[row - 1]
        right := suffixes[row]
        common := 0
        while text[left + common] == text[right + common]
            common += 1
        if symbol_index(text[left + common]) < symbol_index(text[right + common])
            ordered += 1
        lcp_sum += common
        if common > maximum
            maximum = common
            longest_row = row
    return Check(ordered, lcp_sum, maximum, longest_row)
